select 'parity' src, case when recorded_at >= '2026-10-09T14:59:37Z' then 'post' else 'pre' end win, coalesce(live_outcome,'-') live_outcome, coalesce(twin_outcome,'-') twin_outcome, count(*) n
 from live_paper_parity_events where live_tag='Jmmsell10' and recorded_at >= '2026-10-09T09:00:00Z'
 and (series like 'KXATP%' or series like 'KXWTA%' or series like 'KXITF%') group by 1,2,3,4
union all
select 'live_orders', case when created_at >= '2026-10-09T14:59:37Z' then 'post' else 'pre' end, status, '-', count(*)
 from live_orders where strategy='Jmmsell10' and action='buy' and created_at >= '2026-10-09T09:00:00Z'
 and (market_ticker like 'KXATP%' or market_ticker like 'KXWTA%' or market_ticker like 'KXITF%') group by 1,2,3
union all
select 'live_orders_all', case when created_at >= '2026-10-09T14:59:37Z' then 'post' else 'pre' end, 'any', '-', count(*)
 from live_orders where strategy='Jmmsell10' and action='buy' and created_at >= '2026-10-09T09:00:00Z' group by 1,2
order by 1,2,3
